scope: all 6261 physical recording IDs in the canonical stimulus manifest
pronunciation_choice: first CMU dictionary variant, without outcome-based selection
alignment_labels: canonical ARPAbet targets without stress; preserved separately from FALCON LH39 mapping
silence: prepend and append sil to each isolated target word
resampling: torchaudio.functional.resample defaults; full decoded waveform; no trimming or VAD
timestamp_note: retain the pinned official forward implementation's conversion; not exact 10ms boundaries
quality_flags: descriptive automatic flags only; not a manual acceptance gate or calibrated correctness probabilities
interpretation: target-conditioned automatic phone boundaries, not recognized actual pronunciations
